summary.text: Desolate Ancient Moon physique is one of the ten extreme physiques. Gu Yue records also call the same aptitude Ancient Moon Desolate Yin.

claims.text: During the Qing Mao investigation stretch, Gu Yue Bo links Fang Yuan’s rapid rise to the ten extreme set and names Ancient Moon Desolate Yin physique. First gen Gu Yue’s parting words and will predict that Gu Yue clan will produce a Gu Master with the Ancient Moon Desolate Yin body, and order such a physique brought to the blood pond graveyard coffin where a method to curb the ten extreme weakness is said to sleep.
Broader set rules sit on Ten Extreme Physique.

First gen Gu Yue later says he used a blood type Gu to purify his heirs and try to bring out a descendant with Ancient Moon Desolate Yin physique, planning to absorb that genius’s blood and raise his own aptitude sharply toward ninety-nine percent A grade.

Tie Ruo Nan assumes Fang Yuan holds Desolate Ancient Moon physique and that the ten extreme weakness would already have killed the real Fang Yuan, then corrects herself that Bai Ning Bing held Northern Dark Ice Soul physique instead.

According to The Legends of Ren Zu, Desolate Ancient Moon climbs Cheng Bai mountain to search for success Gu and rescue her father from the Door of Life and Death; when that search fails, her brother Northern Dark Ice Soul wakes her.

The two then seek wisdom Gu, which demands one of their middle ages as payment for directions, and Desolate Ancient Moon gives hers without hesitation. It sends them to a blue sea said to hold human-shaped life Gu, warning that fifteen minutes inside means assimilation. Rather than search the vast sea, Desolate Ancient Moon chooses to enter it herself and become such a life Gu, telling her brother the meaning of her life is to bring their father back; she sinks into the sea and is assimilated after fifteen minutes, emerging as a badly damaged, less than half-formed human-shaped gem.

Feng Jin Huang’s revival material names Fairy Lian Xiang, a past Spirit Affinity House fairy, as holding Desolate Ancient Moon physique. Ambushing enemies made her a zombie at rank five; she later succeeded in immortal ascension, and heavenly tribulation with earthly calamity purified the zombie body. Spirit Affinity House Gu Immortals treat ten extreme immortal ascension as one route to shed a zombie body, and her tribulation is described as nearly a rank seven grand tribulation that needed several Spirit Affinity House Gu Immortals’ help.

After reading life-and-death immortal aperture revival, Fang Yuan plans a second revival on his first mortal aperture, cultivating time path so that aperture becomes a super grade blessed land with Desolate Ancient Moon Physique beside Great Strength True Martial Physique.

Desolate Ancient Moon Physique is listed among the ten extreme physiques that, on immortal ascension, produce a super grade blessed land rather than ordinary high, medium, or low grade starting lands.
